class.name: CgamePCGGraph
class.brief_description: Procedural content graph runtime with typed pins, subgraphs, custom nodes, an incremental cache, a debugger and world-partition cell execution.
class.description: [CgamePCGGraph] is a native port of the GDScript [code]pcg_graph.gd[/code] and [code]pcg_presets.gd[/code] libraries, with the same data model and the same deterministic results. Its design follows the publicly documented concepts of UE5's PCG framework (typed pins, point data with attributes, subgraphs, partitioned generation, debug capture). [b]Data[/b] is plain [Dictionary] values tagged by a [code]"type"[/code] key: - [code]points[/code]: [code]{positions: PackedVector3Array, attrs: {density, scale, rotation_y: PackedFloat32Array, seed: PackedInt64Array, custom attributes: PackedFloat32Array}}[/code] - [code]spline[/code]: [code]{points: PackedVector3Array, closed: bool}[/code] - [code]volume[/code]: [code]{aabb: AABB}[/code] - [code]landscape[/code]: [code]{height_at: Callable(x, z) -> float, normal_at: Callable(x, z) -> Vector3}[/code] - [code]mesh_instances[/code] and [code]scene_instances[/code]: [code]{records: [{mesh_id or scene_path, transforms: Array of Transform3D}]}[/code] - [code]layer_weights[/code]: [code]{layer, positions, weights}[/code] Node outputs are cached and shared; nodes must never modify their inputs. [b]Pins[/b] have a type string, which is one of the types above or [code]"any"[/code]. A trailing [code]"[]"[/code] on an input pin type makes it a multi-input pin that receives an [Array]. [b]Built-in nodes:[/b] [code]surface_sampler[/code], [code]spline_sampler[/code], [code]volume_sampler[/code], [code]density_noise[/code], [code]density_filter[/code], [code]self_pruning[/code], [code]difference[/code], [code]transform_points[/code], [code]attribute_set[/code], [code]merge[/code], [code]partition_by_attribute[/code], [code]copy_points[/code], [code]constant_volume[/code], [code]static_mesh_spawner[/code], [code]instanced_scene_output[/code], [code]material_layer_output[/code], plus [code]graph_input[/code], [code]graph_output[/code] and [code]subgraph[/code] (a node whose [code]graph[/code] parameter is another [CgamePCGGraph]). [b]Custom nodes[/b] are registered with [method register_node]. The [Callable] may take [code](inputs)[/code], [code](inputs, params)[/code] or [code](inputs, params, ctx)[/code] and must return a [Dictionary] mapping output pin names to data. [code]ctx[/code] holds [code]node_seed[/code], [code]node_id[/code], [code]has_bounds[/code] and [code]bounds[/code] (the partition cell as [AABB]). [b]Incremental cache:[/b] every node result is cached under a key derived from the node type, parameters, seed, bounds and the hashes of its inputs. Re-running the graph only executes nodes whose key changed; if a changed node produces an identical output, downstream nodes stay cached (early cutoff). [member executed_nodes] lists what actually ran. [b]Partition execution:[/b] [method partition_execute] runs the graph for one world-partition cell. Sampling is restricted to the cell grown by a margin and outputs are cropped to the exact cell, so the union of all cells equals an unpartitioned run. [codeblock] var graph := CgamePCGGraph.forest_scatter() var volume := CgamePCGGraph.make_volume(AABB(Vector3(-60, -10, -60), Vector3(120, 40, 120))) var result := graph.partition_execute(Vector2i(0, 0), 64.0, {"volume": volume, "landscape": landscape, "road": road}) [/codeblock]

method.name: add_graph_input
method.description: Adds a [code]graph_input[/code] node. When this graph is used as a subgraph, [param pin_name] becomes an input pin of the subgraph node. Returns [param id].

method.name: add_graph_output
method.description: Adds a [code]graph_output[/code] node. [param pin_name] is the key of the result returned by [method execute] and the output pin of a subgraph node. Returns [param id].

method.name: add_node
method.description: Adds (or replaces) a node. The parameters are copied. Returns [param id].

method.name: clear_cache
method.description: Drops all cached node results.

method.name: execute
method.description: Runs the graph. [param inputs] maps [code]graph_input[/code] pin names to data. Returns a dictionary mapping [code]graph_output[/code] pin names to data. If validation fails the result is empty and [method get_last_errors] explains why.

method.name: get_cache_hits
method.description: Returns the number of nodes that were served from the cache in the last run.

method.name: get_debug
method.description: Returns the debugger records of the last run keyed by node id. Each record has [code]id[/code], [code]step[/code], [code]type[/code], [code]executed[/code], [code]usec[/code], [code]in_counts[/code], [code]outputs[/code] (summaries from [method summarize]) and, if [member debug_capture_full] is set, [code]full[/code].

method.name: get_debug_steps
method.description: Returns the debugger records of the last run in dependency order, for step-by-step stepping.

method.name: get_executed_nodes
method.description: Returns the ids of the nodes that actually ran in the last run (cache misses), in order. Nodes inside subgraphs are prefixed with the subgraph node id and a slash.

method.name: get_io_pins
method.description: Returns a dictionary mapping the pin names of the graph's inputs (or outputs if [param inputs] is [code]false[/code]) to their pin types.

method.name: get_last_errors
method.description: Returns the validation errors found by the last run.

method.name: get_edges
method.description: Returns the edge list. Each edge is a dictionary with the keys [code]from[/code], [code]from_pin[/code], [code]to[/code] and [code]to_pin[/code]. The returned array shares its storage with the graph.

method.name: get_nodes
method.description: Returns the node dictionary keyed by node id; each value has [code]type[/code] and [code]params[/code]. The returned dictionary shares its storage with the graph.

method.name: get_param
method.description: Returns a node parameter, or [param default_value] if the node or key does not exist.

method.name: hash3
method.description: Mixes three integers into one 64-bit hash.

method.name: landscape_height
method.description: Returns the height of a [code]landscape[/code] data value at [code](x, z)[/code], or [param fallback] if it is not a valid landscape.

method.name: landscape_normal
method.description: Returns the surface normal of a [code]landscape[/code] data value at [code](x, z)[/code], using [code]normal_at[/code] or finite differences of [code]height_at[/code]. Returns [constant Vector3.UP] if the landscape is invalid.

method.name: link
method.description: Adds an edge. Returns an empty string on success, otherwise the validation error (unknown node or pin, incompatible pin types, or an already connected single-input pin); in that case the edge is not added.

method.name: make_landscape
method.description: Creates [code]landscape[/code] data. [param height_at] takes [code](x, z)[/code] and returns a height; [param normal_at] is optional and returns a [Vector3] (derived by finite differences when omitted).

method.name: make_points
method.description: Creates [code]points[/code] data with density 1, scale 1, yaw 0 and a seed derived from each position.

method.name: make_spline
method.description: Creates [code]spline[/code] data.

method.name: make_volume
method.description: Creates [code]volume[/code] data.

method.name: mix64
method.description: Mixes an integer with the SplitMix64 finaliser (public domain).

method.name: node_output
method.description: Returns the output of a node from the last run, or [code]null[/code] if it was not evaluated.

method.name: partition_execute
method.description: Runs the graph for one world-partition cell. Sampling nodes are restricted to the cell grown by [param margin] so neighbour-dependent nodes (such as [code]self_pruning[/code]) see context, and the outputs are cropped to the exact cell. Every cell and margin has its own cache entries.

method.name: pins_compatible
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if an output pin of type [param from_type] may feed an input pin of type [param to_type]. [code]"any"[/code] is a wildcard and a trailing [code]"[]"[/code] is ignored.

method.name: point_count
method.description: Returns the number of points, spline points, layer weights or mesh/scene instances in a data value, or 0 for other values.

method.name: rand01
method.description: Maps the low 24 bits of a hash to [code][0, 1)[/code].

method.name: register_node
method.description: Registers a custom node type. [param input_pins] and [param output_pins] map pin names to pin type strings. [param execute] takes [code](inputs)[/code], [code](inputs, params)[/code] or [code](inputs, params, ctx)[/code] and returns a [Dictionary] mapping output pin names to data.

method.name: run_scoped
method.description: Low-level entry point used by [method execute], [method partition_execute] and subgraph nodes. [param scope] prefixes the cache keys, [param bounds_ctx] holds [code]has_bounds[/code] and [code]bounds[/code], and [param seed_value] replaces the graph seed.

method.name: set_param
method.description: Sets a node parameter. Does nothing if the node does not exist.

method.name: structure_hash
method.description: Returns a hash of the whole graph definition (nodes, parameters, edges, nested subgraphs and seed).

method.name: summarize
method.description: Returns a debugger summary of a data value: [code]type[/code], [code]count[/code] and, for points, [code]sample[/code] (the first [param sample_count] points) and [code]bounds[/code]; for volumes, [code]bounds[/code].

method.name: validate
method.description: Returns the validation errors: unknown node types, subgraph nodes without a graph, invalid or type-mismatched edges, several edges into a single-input pin and cycles. An empty array means the graph is valid.

method.name: forest_scatter
method.description: Creates a dense forest preset with a cleared corridor around a road; steep ground gets rocks instead of trees. Inputs: [code]volume[/code], [code]landscape[/code], [code]road[/code] (spline). Outputs: [code]trees[/code], [code]rocks[/code], [code]floor[/code].

method.name: ruins_debris
method.description: Creates a preset that stamps rubble clusters onto each point of interest. Input: [code]pois[/code] (points). Outputs: [code]debris[/code], [code]ground[/code].

method.name: cave_rocks
method.description: Creates a preset with boulders ringing each cave mouth while the opening itself stays clear. Input: [code]entrances[/code] (points). Output: [code]rocks[/code].

method.name: is_debug_capture_full
method.description: Returns [member debug_capture_full].

method.name: is_debug_enabled
method.description: Returns [member debug_enabled].

members.member: If [code]true[/code], the debugger records keep the full output data of every node ([code]full[/code] key).
If [code]true[/code], every run records per-node debugger information in [method get_debug].
Number of sample points kept in each point summary.
The graph's edges. Prefer [method link], which validates pins.
Seed mixed into every node seed. The same seed and inputs always give the same output.
The graph's nodes keyed by id. Prefer [method add_node].
